description.en: Fills the given arrays with the map's starting camera position and reference point.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] camera position; passed by reference and filled in place.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] look-at reference; passed by reference and filled in place.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Read the map's starting camera position/reference
CMND_GET_START_CAMERA_POS(pos, ref);
